name: The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company
summary: The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company provides medical, motor, and other general insurance in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers third party and comprehensive motor, medical malpractice, and domestic worker contract insurance; roadside assistance; and visit visa extension services.
